'''B3 scanner goggles''' were a model of [[Scanner goggles/Legends|scanner goggles]] made by the company [[Torjeka/Legends|Torjeka]] and sold for 150 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" /> They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and provided users with enhanced vision in darkness.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The B3 scanner goggles was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
